description: Small synthetic financial retrieval benchmark. Facts are fixtures, not claims about real companies.

chunks.text: Acme Corp reported FY2025 revenue of $1.25 billion, compared with $1.10 billion in FY2024.
For FY2024, total revenue was $1.10 billion and operating expenses were $820 million.
Acme Corp net income for FY2025 was $146 million, while diluted earnings per share was $2.18.
International expansion was constrained by distributor onboarding delays, local licensing requirements, and shortages of experienced regional managers.
Operating margin improved because higher subscription revenue and pricing discipline more than offset wage inflation and cloud infrastructure costs.
Under Basel III, the bank disclosed a common equity tier 1 capital adequacy ratio of 13.4 percent at year end.
The risk outlook emphasizes foreign exchange volatility, cybersecurity incidents, customer concentration, and uncertain interest-rate conditions.
European operations experienced longer delivery times after semiconductor shortages disrupted the supply chain and reduced factory throughput.
Cash and cash equivalents were $310 million. The revolving credit facility remained undrawn at the reporting date.
The board declared a final dividend of $0.42 per ordinary share for the 2024 reporting period.
